}}'''Noram''' is a cook working for the [[Band of the Red Hand]].{{ref/book|13|17}}

== Activities ==
Noram works tirelessly in [[Mat Cauthon]]'s army. When Noram is away from cooking, such as looking for provisions, meals often end up being cooked slowly.{{Ref/book|13|17}}

==Trivia==
*Noram is named after Norm Miller, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
